Set domain to process/material magnetic condition, not supplier.
Keep section 1 and 2 gauss results and function results as core outcomes with row-level citations.
Verify rows 17,18,20,23,24,26 and attach CMG/SMG rows under the correct NG or OK parent condition.
Remove or separately rebuild F0/THD/SPL outcomes only if their rows explicitly compare Gauss OK and Gauss NG.
